tools.purpose: Saved-output analysis extensions, hypothetical-household simulation code, deterministic Matplotlib figure code, code and statistical checks, primary-source literature review, simulated referee exercises and manuscript preparation

figures: Six scientific charts are rendered by Matplotlib from model-calculated hypothetical-household points and saved population aggregates. Language-model assistance supported coding and presentation; no image-generation model supplies chart pixels or numerical observations. paper/build_figures.py performs no tax-benefit simulation. Figure and source hashes appear in paper/checks/figure-provenance.json.
reproduction: The executable estimators, model and input versions, seeds, aggregate manifests and manuscript sources reproduce reported results without replaying generative-AI prompts. The frozen 2025 model scenario is not validated current law; the mixed 2017-oriented scenario appears in the appendix. Prompts informed software development and prose, not an LLM-valued empirical outcome.
